svg.title: High glucose: the same cut-offs decide prediabetes or diabetes for both types; below the line sit the grey zone and pre-symptomatic type 1 (autoantibodies), above it the presentation, C-peptide and anti-GAD antibodies separate new-onset type 1 from type 2; each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: High glucose: is it DIABETES, and WHICH TYPE?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: the same cut-offs for type 1 and type 2: they mark where RETINOPATHY risk rises

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: symptoms (thirst, polyuria, weight loss) → ONE abnormal test is enough · none → repeat on ANOTHER day

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: acutely ill (heart attack, sepsis, high-dose steroids) → suspect, confirm once recovered

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: BELOW the line: NOT YET diabetes

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: grey zone: fasting 6.1–6.9 · 2-h 75 g 7.8–11.0 mmol/L · glycated hemoglobin (A1c)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: AT or ABOVE the line: DIABETES

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ANY ONE: fasting ≥ 7.0 · 2-h 75 g or random ≥ 11.1 mmol/L · A1c ≥ 6.5% (adults,

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: WHICH TYPE? Usually time and the response to treatment tell

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: still unsure → C-peptide (is she making insulin?) + anti-glutamic acid decarboxylase
